modify.note: Booker DatePicker (packages/features/bookings/Booker/components/DatePicker.tsx): make the booker's automatic month advance depend on availability in the month being displayed. The CRM-owner lookup can return slots from the following month, so deriving one list of nonempty days from the whole response incorrectly makes an empty current month look bookable. Restrict the dates used for this decision to the browsing month and year, using the existing nonempty-schedule-day logic. Keep the existing restriction that automatic advancement applies to the current month. Wait for a completed availability response before deciding that the month is empty; missing data or an in-progress fetch should not trigger navigation. When the loaded current month has no bookable days, advance through the existing month-change callback so the selected date and day-count state stay consistent. A bookable day in the displayed month must prevent advancement even when the response spans multiple months. Decouple the booker DatePicker from the schedule-query object by accepting `slots` and `isLoading` directly. Update callers. Add the shared `Slots` type in packages/features/bookings/types.ts.

Calendar DatePicker (packages/features/calendars/DatePicker.tsx): keep the actual slot data available to the calendar for rendering and out-of-office information. Use `isLoading` consistently in the calendar component. Expose the named `DatePicker` export as specified. Expose the month label as a `<time>` element with its machine-readable `dateTime` value as specified.

add_edges.label: renders calendar DatePicker
add_edges.note: The booker DatePicker passes the actual slot data (`slots`) to the calendar DatePicker for rendering and out-of-office information, and passes `isLoading`; month changes go through the existing month-change callback (`onMonthChange`).
